The problem

Growth work was scattered, slow, and off-brand.

  • Disconnected tools. A dashboard here, an email builder there, competitor intel in spreadsheets — the same context re-derived in every tool, every week.
  • No shared plan. If nobody sat down to plan the month, there was no plan. Festivals were remembered too late.
  • Brand drift. Every generator and freelancer started from scratch: wrong greens, wrong fonts, "hurry — last chance!" copy the style guide bans.
  • Blind to the market. No systematic view of what 30+ competitor brands were sending, discounting, or launching.
  • No memory. Winning campaigns weren't captured anywhere a future campaign could learn from.
  • The cost: days from idea → mailer, inconsistent output, and retention decisions made from stale exports.

5-step wizard — brief → products → generation → review → final HTML

Domain 07 · Autonomy

Automated Calendar Creation — the department runs itself; humans approve.

Rolling 90-day plan — review, preview the full funnel, approve or reject
  • Every morning (03:30 UTC) the Brain re-plans a rolling 90-day calendar per market against fresh data, festivals and competitor moves — without touching anything a human already approved.
  • Every slot arrives scored (cohort, objective, channels, confidence %) with the full funnel previewable before approval.
  • Approve = generate everything: mailer + Meta/Google/TikTok ads + a hosted landing page at /lp/:id — in one click.
  • Safety by design: nothing sends automatically (Phase 2 gate); weekly human recalibration is mandatory.

Under the hood

Engineered to be unbreakable and (almost) free.

6-provider AI waterfall

OpenAI → Anthropic → Gemini → Grok → Groq → Cerebras. If a provider fails or runs out of credit, the system degrades to free tiers instead of failing. No single-vendor dependency.

Image cascade + brand placeholder

Gemini → Imagen → GPT-Image → Pollinations (free) → on-brand placeholder. A campaign never ships a broken image tile.

Exactly 12 functions

The Vercel free-plan cap, treated as a design constraint: action-routers + shared modules mean new features cost ~zero new infrastructure.

Brand kernel in code

4 colors, 2 typefaces, banned/preferred phrase lists enforced at generation time — client-side check + server-side scrub. Compliance is a property of the system, not a review step.

Keyless Google auth

Workload Identity Federation: no stored Google keys anywhere. Cron and webhooks secret-protected; service-role keys never reach the browser.

Real data engines

Supabase (40+ tables) + offline DuckDB pipeline for Shopify/Klaviyo/WebEngage exports; catalogs rebuilt at every deploy (US 173 · UK 101 · Global 102 products).

Everywhere the team is

The mobile super app — the whole OS in your pocket.

  • One app, all eleven tools. Installable PWA + native Android and iOS apps (Capacitor shells over the live deployment).
  • Auto-synced by architecture: the native apps render production directly — every web deploy is a mobile release. The complete Android + iOS project code lives in this repo; there is no second repo to drift.
  • Approve from your phone: the Automated Calendar Creation's pending approvals, KicksGPT, dashboards — all mobile-ready with the same login.
  • Downloadable builds published by CI to a fixed link (GitHub → Releases → mobile-latest) — verified building green:
    ✓ Android APK — direct install ✓ iOS IPA — sideload / TestFlight-ready
  • Next: Play Store & App Store listings + push notifications for pending approvals (Phase 2).

The vision

Phase 2: close the loop. Then let it compound.

Now →Closed-loop sending

Klaviyo goes live with one API key (every request already dry-runs today). Approved campaigns push themselves; performance flows back into the Brain's winner thresholds.

NextDelegated autonomy

Auto-approve above confidence thresholds with per-market spend caps — humans set policy, the Brain executes, weekly recalibration stays mandatory.

ThenCompounding intelligence

Every asset, approval, rejection and competitor move feeds retrieval-augmented generation. The system's taste improves with use — that's the moat.

ScaleBeyond one brand

The brand kernel is one module; KicksGPT renames in one line. The same OS can run any D2C brand's growth loop — or every KNICKGASM market as its own instance.

The end state: a growth team that spends its time on strategy and taste — while the OS does the reading, planning, writing, designing and remembering. Humans approve; the machine compounds.
